description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port City (Authorized Person Engaged in Business) Regulations No 01 of 2023
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. The content focuses entirely on establishing legal and regulatory frameworks for business operations, currency conversions, land transactions, and compliance requirements within the Colombo Port City economic zone. While a minister's name appears, it is only in the context of issuing these regulations, not detailing personal portfolio responsibilities. The primary content is regulatory in nature, establishing legal requirements and procedures.
